author: TheKeyCrafter
body:
Ello' guys :) I've decided to make the forums a little more fun by having these little games. So this one's called How well are you known? Where you rate a player that posted above you on how well you know him on a scale of 1 to 10. What are you waiting for? Start :)

Don't be saddened or disheartened if you get a low rating :)
